results.title: Prostate Cancer Awareness Month promotes early testing for curable disease
results.description: Prostate cancer is a disease that physicians say if detected early is highly curable. September is Prostate Cancer Awareness Month and survivors and advocates gather at the State Capitol to ask men to get tested.

results.title: Federal funding arrives as hospital closures continue across Georgia
results.description: The closed Hancock County hospital illustrates the health care problem faced by rural communities across Georgia. Will federal funding help?
